params.name: code
params.description: The code used to search for a specific coupon.

params.name: status
params.description: The status of the coupons to search for. Options: claimed, redeemed, invalid, expired, unassigned, partially_redeemed

params.name: limit
params.description: Limits the number of results to be returned in one response.

params.name: page
params.description: This parameter gets a specific page of the coupon list if a limit has been set. This is used in pagination in conjunction with the limit query.

items.docs:
Use this endpoint to query coupons within Antavo independently of customer data. 
This allows searching for coupons based on criteria such as coupon code and status, providing flexibility in managing coupon data.
